questions.question: When King Hezekiah became very sick, what did the LORD tell him through the prophet Isaiah?

answers.text: Put your house in order because you will die
Rest a while and you will feel better soon
Send for a doctor from Egypt right away

questions.question: After King Hezekiah prayed and wept, how many years did the LORD say He would add to his life?
To treat King Hezekiah's boil, what did the prophet Isaiah say to prepare?

answers.text: A wrap of myrrh and linen

questions.question: Isaiah offered King Hezekiah a sign that the LORD would heal him. What were the two choices?

answers.text: A shadow goes forward or back ten steps
The sun stands still or sets early
Rain falls or the river runs dry
